metadata.source: PSOC - AzCopy Selective File type Exfiltration.yaml

metadata.description: Microsoft Sentinel Log Analytics workspace name

properties.displayName: PSOC- AzCopy Selective File type Exfiltration
properties.description: Detects execution of AzCopy with file selection parameters that may indicate targeted data transfer or potential exfiltration of sensitive files.
properties.query:
// Detects execution of AzCopy with file selection parameters that may indicate targeted data transfer or potential exfiltration of sensitive files.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where FileName has "azcopy"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--include-pattern","--include-after","--recursive")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".zip",".pst",".bak",".sql",".docx",".xlsx",".pdf",".xlsm",".xlsb",".xltx",".csv",".doc",".rtf",".ppt",".pps",".sqlite",".mdb",".accdb","..QBW",".QBB",".QBA",".QBY",".QBX",".qbw",".qbb",".qbm",".qba",".qby",".qbx")
| where ProcessCommandLine has "http"
//| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountUpn = InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, ProcessCommandLine
| extend
    Computer = tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceName", "")),
    Account = tostring(column_ifexists("InitiatingProcessAccountName", "")),
    ProcessId = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessId", "")),
    CommandLine = tostring(column_ifexists("ProcessCommandLine", ""))
| where isnotempty(Computer)
